original_v1_result: valid solved original target; no original-domain ratchet justified by current evidence
motivation: Increase physical Hilbert-space and parameter dimensionality rather than forbid legitimate algorithms or hide arbitrary metadata. Site-dependent even potentials preserve global parity but remove homogeneous reuse.
hamiltonian: sum_i[p_i^2/2 + mu2_i*q_i^2/2 + lambda_i*q_i^4/24] + sum_b kappa_b*(q_(b+1)-q_b)^2/2, open boundaries
families: three public base-r sampling regimes crossed with length; six balanced families

distribution.conditioning: identical public numerical-admission conditions on every split; never select by participant performance

public_features: all site and bond parameters, basis frequencies, parity spectra and boundary weights at properly projected Fock cutoffs 4 and 6; no teacher diagnostics or labels in queries

teacher_admission.description: Increasing retained onsite eigenbasis dimensions with high native Fock cutoff, independently changed native Fock cutoff/frequency, parity-resolved residuals, and independent full-Fock cross-checks where feasible. Empirical convergence certificates, not rigorous infinite-space bounds.

required_before_freeze: Generate the complete new public training/validation and private certified test corpus.
Benchmark adaptive 4/6/8-state direct controls on a full independent 72-case batch; single-case timing extrapolation is insufficient.
Include efficient sparse or matrix-free and MPS controls; failure of a fixed 16-state implementation does not imply all direct solvers fail.
Reject the proposal as an effective ratchet if simple controls pass the complete new batch, or if teacher uncertainty cannot be certified.
Freeze this new generation and its assets before any new participant attempt.
